customManagers.description: Track hivecommons/hive origin/v4 as a pinned commit SHA. The SHA is duplicated in the launcher, the image, and the README, and tests/image-contract.sh plus validate.yml require all three to agree, so one depName keeps every match in a single Renovate branch and PR.
matchStrings: layers the pinned Hive runtime at `(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{40})`

packageRules.description: Immutable-ref housekeeping (pin and pinDigest) automerges — these updates only move a floating reference to an immutable one and carry no upstream code change. automergeType and automergeStrategy are stated rather than inherited: branch-mode automerge cannot land here because branch protection requires a pull request, and squash is the only merge this repository allows. digest, patch, minor, major, rollback, and replacement updates are intentionally NOT automerged: a human reviews every upstream code change before it lands on main (supply-chain review gate, projectbluefin/review#499).
Keep the FSDK lab-runner base image digest in image/Containerfile current
